name: Pi Agent
description: Embeds a pi coding-agent session inside the extension. 'ask' sends a prompt to pi and returns its final response; 'reset' starts a fresh session.

commands.title: Ask pi
commands.description: Send a prompt to a pi agent session and return its final response.

commands.title: Reset pi session
commands.description: Dispose the current pi session so the next 'ask' starts fresh.

commands.title: Pi session status
commands.description: Shows whether a pi session is active, its cwd, model and thinking level.
